## Professional Summary

Milton Ngala is a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in .NET Core, C#, React, Next.js,
TypeScript, and Azure cloud architecture. He designs and builds scalable enterprise systems,
full-stack web applications, REST APIs, and cloud-native services. He is based in Nairobi and
works with clients globally.

## Core Technical Specialisation

Backend: .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework, Node.js, Express
Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router, SSR/ISR), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
Databases: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
Cloud & DevOps: Azure (App Service, Functions, Storage, Azure SQL), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD
Architecture: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Microservices, CQRS, REST APIs
Payments & Integrations: Stripe, M-Pesa, SignalR, third-party API integration

## Engineering Expertise

- Enterprise backend system design and architecture
- Scalable REST API development with .NET Core
- Microservices decomposition and cloud migration (AWS/Azure)
- Legacy system modernisation using strangler fig and incremental rewrite patterns
- Full-stack MVP development for startups and product teams
- Real-time systems with SignalR and WebSockets
- CI/CD pipeline setup and automation (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
- Technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering mentorship
